bindings.caption: Charge triethylene glycol and mesyl chloride in THF; cool. Charge triethylene glycol and mesyl chloride in THF; cool A flask is reported; capacity and neck count are not reported. Cooling medium is unspecified.

Add triethylamine dropwise while stirring. Triethylamine is added dropwise over the stated interval while stirring the cooled mixture. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Allow to warm to room temperature and stir. Allow to warm to room temperature and stir Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Dilute with water and add sodium bicarbonate. Dilute with water and add sodium bicarbonate Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Add sodium azide to biphasic mixture. Sodium azide is added; a still head is fitted before the following solvent removal. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Distil off THF. THF is distilled off; numerical distillation temperature and duration are not stated. Source reports a flask fitted with a still head; dimensions and condenser design remain illustrative.

Reflux the remaining aqueous mixture. Reflux follows THF removal, once only water remains. No numerical reflux temperature is assigned. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Cool, extract into chloroform and dry over magnesium sulfate. Retain the chloroform organic extract after drying; extraction volume and number of portions are unreported. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Remove solvent under reduced pressure. Remove solvent under reduced pressure Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Flash chromatography in chloroform/methanol. Retain isolated compound 1 fractions, reported as a colourless oil. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.
